name: vivido
description: Vivido — kiralık ev bulma, kişiselleştirilmiş skorlama ve ziyaret rotası (web + mobil)

scripts.test: pnpm test:api && pnpm test:web && pnpm test:mobile
scripts.format:mobile: cd mobile && dart format --set-exit-if-changed lib test
scripts.infra:down: docker compose --profile dev --profile routing --profile full down
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose --profile dev --profile routing --profile full down -v && docker compose --profile dev up -d
scripts.db:check: docker compose exec -T postgis psql -U vivido -d vivido -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /checks/dq.sql
scripts.db:seed:ref: docker compose exec -T postgis psql -U vivido -d vivido -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/002_seed_reference.sql
